test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All cats are dogs.

II. Some cats are rabbits.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some dogs are rabbits.

II. All rabbits are dogs.

options.text: Both conclusion I and II follows

solution: The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below : [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e6a9db5018643602b68ae7f78888c2d3bc800775cbf3cfc051ed16ba80b29f7.png] Conclusions: I. Some dogs are rabbits → **F**ollow (As all cats are dogs and some cats are rabbits. As whole cats comes in dogs and has some part common with rabbits, therefore it is true.)
